finding.trigger: New ci-browser/full profile invokes the default Playwright application suite.
finding.before: playwright.config.ts omitted outputDir; Playwright's test-results default removes the qualifier's running report directory and prior receipts. Later saveReport would fail with ENOENT.
evidence: Installed Playwright 1.62.1 lib/common/index.js resolves the default outputDir to package test-results.
Installed Playwright 1.62.1 lib/runner/index.js createRemoveOutputDirsTask removes selected project output directories before execution.
finding.after: Default suite owns test-results/apps; discovery rejects actual project output paths equal to, above or below test-results/store-qualification. Shared outputs within an application profile remain supported.
finding.unrelatedObservation: This browser execution cleanup issue does not explain the prior #52 non-browser replaced-homepage-shell observation.
